stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait before you start. The game asks for landscape itself, with a prompt telling you to turn the phone.
stumbles.why: Seems contradictory: you lock rotation in portrait, yet you're later told to turn the phone to landscape. It's unclear whether a locked screen will let the game go landscape, or whether the game works around the lock.

point: Tilt Rally is a phone-tilt racing game: pick track, laps and difficulty in portrait, turn to landscape when prompted, and steer by tilting left/right and accelerate or brake by tilting the top away from or toward you, relative to your starting neutral position.
